name: Crooked Cowboy Public House
address: 5165 SW Club House Rd, Crooked River Ranch, OR 97760

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single-story commercial building with a brown shingle roof and multiple roof planes|A paved parking lot with marked spaces, including an accessible space and hashed no-parking zones, sits along one side of the building|A wooden deck with outdoor tables runs along another side|A sand or dirt patio with picnic tables occupies an adjacent yard|Landscaping, gravel beds, and a paved walkway wrap the building|Neighboring commercial and recreation buildings share the same campus.

alpha.desc: The front of the building faces a paved parking lot with marked spaces and hashed striping|The structure has a brown shingle roof and a covered side area|A wooden deck with outdoor tables is visible along one elevation|A paved walkway and landscaped beds run beside the building|Trees and open lawn sit at the edge of the lot.

bravo.desc: The left side of the building shows the long roof mass, the paved parking lot, and the sand patio with picnic tables|Rooftop equipment is visible on the brown shingle roof|A smaller attached or adjacent roofed section sits near the patio|A paved walkway and landscaped area run along the opposite side|Open circulation space is present in the lot.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows the sand patio with picnic tables, a fenced or enclosed service area with stored items and a smaller roofed structure, and the wooden deck with outdoor tables on the opposite side|The paved parking lot remains visible along the front|Multiple roof planes and rooftop equipment are present|Landscaping and a walkway border one side of the building.

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows the wooden deck with outdoor tables facing a paved walkway, gravel beds, and lawn|The paved parking lot extends along the opposite elevation|The sand patio with picnic tables is visible at the far end|Trees stand at the corner of the lot|A stop marking is painted on the pavement near the lot edge.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from SW Club House Rd into a paved parking lot with marked spaces and open circulation. The building is a single-story commercial structure with a brown shingle roof, a wooden deck, and an adjacent sand patio. The site sits within a larger recreation campus that includes additional buildings, a swimming pool, tennis courts, golf course turf, and a large shared parking area. Walkways connect the building to neighboring structures and lawn areas. Outdoor seating and stored items occupy sides of the building and may affect movement immediately against those walls.
clarifications: Which door is the primary public entrance? Is the sand patio public seating or a restricted service yard? Do any gates control access between this lot and the larger campus parking area? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle route through the lot? Is vehicle access available around all four sides of the building, or is the service side limited to pedestrian use?
